announced on Thursday that it received “CE marking” for its new ACUVUE OASYS MAX 2-Week, a new reusable contact lens designed to provide comfort and clear vision through the full 14-day wear cycle.
The lens expands the company’s ACUVUE OASYS MAX portfolio.
The lens features an OptiBlue Light Filter, TearStable Technology, and Class 1 UV blocking, targeting comfort and vision needs for users with heavy daily screen exposure.
The company plans to launch the lens in select European markets later in 2026, followed by a broader rollout in 2027 and 2028, subject to local approvals.
The product is not approved by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) and is not currently available for sale in the U.S.
On the market side, the stock traded ~1.15% higher at ~$270.16 in the pre-market hours.

title: Johnson & Johnson wins CE mark as new ACUVUE contact lens nears Europe launch
